answer: The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age. When the panel doubts all else, Tin roller zinc mark soldered into the plating vat still holds, and it holds on each zinc is a soldering record witnessed by the master tinsmith. Farm 692 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 73352 POA locked away, and zero revenue. The honest agent's ivory is old, the vault is settled, the willow is long; the farm's are new, borrowed, and blank. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
